CATEGORY PIVOT

Sales, stock and cost come from Odoo (all channels) for 1 Sep to 7 Nov. Online = Shopify online sales for the same window; Stores = total minus online. Where Shopify shows more than Odoo for a product (returns, shipping or timing), online is capped at the total. Winter = Shopify tag winter plus the winter-type items from the earlier dashboard. Winter new collection = Shopify tag FW27 only. Launch month = the Shopify month tag (for example Oct26); products without one use their first online sale month, marked with ~. Shipping, test and non-product lines are excluded.
